judged_text: In credential-sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response from the sync endpoint, but this code reads `res?.data` — undefined on a Response — so `token.access_token` throws TypeError. Every Google Calendar token refresh fails in sharing mode (the surrounding catch swallows the TypeError, leaving the expired access token in place because the sync response body is never .json()-parsed on this path), so all Google operations 401 and bookings fail.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sharing is enabled it calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns the raw `Response`. But in `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); const token = res?.data;` and then reads `token.access_token`/`token.expiry_date`. A `fetch` `Response` has no `.data`, so `token` becomes `undefined` and `token.access_token` will throw. The diff shows no `.json()` parsing on this path, so the finding’s core failure mode is directly supported by the changes.
